summary_en: Nadofaragene firadenovec is being tested in adults with low-grade upper tract urothelial carcinoma (LG-UTUC), a cancer of the upper urinary tract. It is instilled into the renal pelvis; the record describes repeat dosing, but the number, schedule and length of dosing are not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability, plus complete response at 3 or 6 months, defined as no UTUC in the renal pelvis.
summary_es: Se está probando nadofaragene firadenovec en adultos con carcinoma urotelial de tracto superior de bajo grado (LG-UTUC), un cáncer de las vías urinarias superiores. Se administra por instilación en la pelvis renal; el registro describe dosis repetidas, pero el número, el calendario y la duración de las dosis no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, además de la respuesta completa a los 3 o 6 meses, definida como ausencia de UTUC en la pelvis renal.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older who can give written informed consent.
Biopsy-proven low-grade upper tract urothelial cancer confirmed by pathology report within 2 months before enrollment.
At least one measurable papillary low-grade tumor of 5 to 15 mm above the ureteropelvic junction.
Willing to be available for at least 18 months after first dosing.
ECOG status of 2 or less and life expectancy over 2 years.
not_for: High-grade cytology or histology, or multifocal UTUC (some low-grade exceptions listed).
Current or past carcinoma in situ or muscle-invasive urothelial cancer in the urogenital tract.
Current or prior mitomycin gel or investigational drug for UTUC.
Known hypersensitivity to nadofaragene firadenovec, interferon alpha-2b, or adenovector medications.
Urinary tract infection or bacterial cystitis at screening (allowed once successfully treated).
